6f48a6e9fa.q: What is Meaningful AI's core philosophy on how artificial intelligence should impact human jobs and capabilities?
6f48a6e9fa.a: Meaningful AI's core tenet is humanity—the view that AI has the opportunity to remove monotonous non-human tasks like copying and pasting, freeing people to focus on human judgment where AI as a probabilistic model is not good. Rather than eliminating jobs, AI should enhance human capabilities and empower people, with humans needing to monitor, create judgment around, and act on AI-generated information.

c28eadcade.q: How did Matt McKenzie transition from technology engineering into entrepreneurship and business development at Alloy Digital?
c28eadcade.a: After graduating from Vanderbilt, McKenzie took a job supporting the university's IT infrastructure, which gave him real-world experience. When he later worked at a company in Tuscaloosa, he pitched a product idea, was allowed to build it, and then was sent to sell it directly to major companies like Reynolds, Rubbermaid, Tyco, and Alcoa—this sales experience taught him the critical difference between building what engineers think is needed versus what customers actually want, launching his entrepreneurial journey.

cf6918d5a2.q: What is the fundamental principle McKenzie advises entrepreneurs to follow before launching a company?
cf6918d5a2.a: McKenzie advises entrepreneurs to never start a company without starting with a client first, partnering with that client to determine what actually fits their needs. By demonstrating market traction—showing that at least one real company will pay for your solution—you prove you are solving a genuine problem, creating a foundation to build a sustainable business around.
